name: orb_narrow_range_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY's 15-minute opening range (09:15-09:30) is narrower than each of the prior 4 sessions' opening ranges, it signals that FII and institutional participants have withheld their directional aggression at the open — a cross-session compression that is qualitatively different from typical ORB days. The thin stop-order stack just above OR_high and below OR_low (because both bulls and bears were cautious this open) means the first breakout bar faces minimal resting limit supply at the OR boundary, allowing NIFTY to extend 20-35 spot points without the usual resistance from participants who positioned during the opening range. At 5-second resolution we can enter within 5 seconds of the close breaking above OR_high (vs. waiting for a 1-minute bar confirm), capturing the initial institutional acceleration before the next wave of TWAP orders fills in the liquidity vacuum.

indicators.name: or_high
indicators.formula: max(high) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: 15-minute OR is a FIXED TIME WINDOW (09:15-09:30 = 180 bars × 5s). Not scaled — the institutional information absorption window on NIFTY is 15 minutes regardless of bar frequency. This is the exact same window the original uses.

indicators.name: or_low
indicators.formula: min(low) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: Lower boundary of 15-min OR. Together with or_high defines the range that must be broken to signal directional commitment.

indicators.name: or_range
indicators.purpose: Today's OR width in NIFTY spot points. The core metric for NR4 comparison — must be strictly less than each of the prior 4 sessions' or_range values.

indicators.name: nr4_condition
indicators.purpose: Cross-session NR4 gate. NOT a fixed bar lookback but a cross-day comparison. Requires at least 4 prior sessions with valid ORBs. On NIFTY, this fires on roughly 15-20% of sessions — infrequent but high-conviction when triggered. The original used exactly this cross-session NR4 logic; we preserve it because the mechanism (institutional restraint across multiple sessions building to a release) is unchanged when applied to the index vs. individual stocks.

indicators.name: or_vol_avg
indicators.formula: mean(volume) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570)
indicators.purpose: Average 5-second volume during the 15-min OR. Establishes the baseline institutional participation level at today's open. Breakout volume compared against this baseline to confirm directional flow (not noise).

indicators.name: vol_3
indicators.purpose: 15-second rolling volume at breakout bar. The 3-bar window smooths 5-second noise while still being responsive to the immediate breakout surge. Threshold: vol_3 > 1.3x or_vol_avg (slightly less demanding than opening_range_breakout_v1's 1.5x because NR4 condition is already a quality filter).

conditions: nr4_condition == True (today's OR is narrowest in 4 sessions)
close > or_high (bar closes above OR boundary)
close in upper 25% of bar range (close_pct > 0.75 — body confirmation at 5s resolution)
vol_3 > 1.3 * or_vol_avg (elevated volume vs OR baseline)
or_range between 0.05% and 2.0% of or_low (valid OR — not degenerate)
time_minutes in [570, 720) — after OR established, before 12:00 IST
buy_ce.confirmation: Single bar — close above or_high with bar body in upper quarter and volume elevated. NR4 already provides quality gate; 3-bar persistence (as in opening_range_breakout_v1) is skipped to avoid being too late on narrow-range breakouts that can move 10 pts in 15s.

conditions: close in lower 25% of bar range (close_pct < 0.25)
buy_pe.confirmation: Single bar breakdown below or_low with body in lower quarter and volume surge.

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points at ATM delta ~0.5. On NR4 ORB days the opening range itself is narrow (often 15-25 pts); if NIFTY retraces 10 spot pts back into the OR after breaking out, the directional commitment has reversed and the NR4 breakout has failed. The 5-pt stop gives 1:1.8 R:R at the 9-pt target. This stop is calibrated to the typical false-breakout retracement on NR4 days, where the compressed range means even false moves are smaller than average ORB days.
exit.target_rationale: 9 option points = ~18 NIFTY spot points. NR4 ORB breakouts on NIFTY extend further than average ORBs because the thin order book at OR boundaries allows the initial leg to run. At 5s resolution with a 120s max hold, 18 spot pts is achievable in the bottom quartile of NR4 ORB expansions (typical first-leg is 20-40 pts). Targeting 18 pts captures ~50% of the median move at 1:1.8 R:R.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 12:00 IST (no new ORB signals after 12:00; NR4 momentum is front-loaded)

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; NR4 ORB reliability deteriorates at extreme VIX — the opening compression is often artificial (no liquidity, not genuine equilibrium)
filters.time_filter: entry only 09:30-12:00 IST; original specified 09:30-10:30 but extending to 12:00 allows re-entry if first breakout fails and a second attempt forms — NR4 days tend to have one strong directional leg
filters.volume_filter: vol_3 > 1.3x or_vol_avg; volume confirms institutional directional intent at the breakout bar
filters.trend_filter: none — NR4 ORB can break either way; the compression is the signal, not the direction

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — cross-session NR4 applied to NIFTY intraday opening range is not widely practiced; most ORB algos fire on any breakout without the NR4 quality gate, leaving this niche underexplored

adaptation_notes: The original uses NR4 on individual NIFTY 50 stocks' 15-minute ORBs and holds 20-180 minutes. Conversion preserves the core innovation — cross-session NR4 as a quality gate on the ORB — while replacing: (1) stock universe with NIFTY index directly; (2) 20-180 min hold with 30-120 second hold (at 5s resolution, we trade the initial breakout impulse rather than the full extension); (3) 1-min bar body confirmation with close-in-upper-quarter check at 5s; (4) ATR-based trailing stop with flat 5pt stop (trailing too complex at 120s hold); (5) market order with limit order at candle close. The NR4 cross-session logic is preserved exactly — the pattern applies to NIFTY index equally well because NIFTY's opening range compression reflects the same macro/FII uncertainty dynamics across sessions that drive compression in individual stocks.
weaknesses: NR4 condition fires on only ~15-20% of sessions — very low signal frequency (avg 1-2 signals/session when triggered)
With 12 days of backtest data and ~15% NR4 frequency, only 1-2 NR4 days exist in sample — insufficient to estimate edge reliably
First 4 trading days in the dataset produce no NR4 signals (insufficient prior history)
Close-in-upper-quarter confirmation may be too strict at 5s bars where large bid/offer impacts closing position within bar
NIFTY OR on extreme macro days (RBI policy, budget) may be anomalously wide or narrow for non-structural reasons, polluting the NR4 signal
